protocol_metadata.about: SUNSwap V3 is a decentralized exchange on the TRON blockchain featuring concentrated liquidity to improve capital efficiency. Launched June 28, 2023, it allows users to add liquidity within customized price ranges and fee tiers, following the Uniswap V3 model adapted for the TRON ecosystem. Trading fees are distributed to liquidity providers based on position proportion.
